title: Matchday now writes its own recaps, plus a Q&A page
items: A new Insights tab publishes short, auto-generated recap posts per sport — hit rate, calibration, and the week's biggest storylines — built entirely from the model's own graded picks, not third-party content.
A new Q&A page explains what confidence, edge, Elo and the opponent-adjusted rating actually mean, and how the model is graded.
